name: Summer houses/chalets
description:
Wooden summer houses and chalets

31 wooden summer houses and chalets from €4,979, with 15 to 74 m² inside. These are bigger than a garden cabin: many have two to five rooms and a terrace, and 15 models come with shutters. Solid log walls from 28 to 68 mm, delivered as a kit to the UK, Ireland and Europe.

Choosing a summer house

A summer house is a place to stay, not only to sit. Pick it by how many people sleep there and how long into the year you want to use it.

Walls. 44 mm suits spring to autumn. 58 and 68 mm logs are the choice if you want to stay longer in the year and add insulation and heating.

Terrace and shutters. 21 models have a terrace, up to 20 m² on the largest. Shutters are listed on 15 models.

Rooms. Where the room count is listed, layouts go from two to five rooms. The floor plan is on each product page.

Need something to live in all year? See insulated wooden houses and villas and country houses.

Summer house questions

Is a summer house the same as a garden room? Not quite. A garden room is usually one insulated room for daily use. A summer house has several rooms and is built for stays in the warmer months.

How do I protect the wood? Treat it soon after assembly. Our wood treatment guide explains how.
